requirements.quote: • /home/user/cloud_migration exists and contains two sub-directories exactly named
• Inside services there are three service folders, each holding one configuration file called config.yml:

check.cmd: test -f /home/user/cloud_migration/services/auth-service/config.yml && test ! -L /home/user/cloud_migration/services/auth-service/config.yml && test -f /home/user/cloud_migration/services/db-service/config.yml && test ! -L /home/user/cloud_migration/services/db-service/config.yml && test -f /home/user/cloud_migration/services/api-service/config.yml && test ! -L /home/user/cloud_migration/services/api-service/config.yml

requirements.quote: • An additional directory /home/user/current_services exists as the single place that deployment jobs will read.
2. Required symbolic links – all using **absolute** paths as link targets, and every link must be unbroken:

check.cmd: test -L /home/user/current_services/auth.yaml && test "$(readlink /home/user/current_services/auth.yaml)" = /home/user/cloud_migration/services/auth-service/config.yml && test -L /home/user/current_services/db.yaml && test "$(readlink /home/user/current_services/db.yaml)" = /home/user/cloud_migration/services/db-service/config.yml && test -L /home/user/current_services/api.yaml && test "$(readlink /home/user/current_services/api.yaml)" = /home/user/cloud_migration/services/api-service/config.yml && test -L /home/user/current_services/all-services && test "$(readlink /home/user/current_services/all-services)" = /home/user/cloud_migration/services

requirements.quote: 5. Broken or relative links are forbidden.  Every link must resolve successfully when followed from anywhere on the filesystem.

check.cmd: test -e /home/user/current_services/auth.yaml && test -e /home/user/current_services/db.yaml && test -e /home/user/current_services/api.yaml && test -e /home/user/current_services/all-services && test -z "$(find /home/user/current_services -type l ! -exec test -e {} \; -print)"

requirements.quote: 3. File contents – each config.yml file must exist and contain only the two lines shown below, ending with a single newline character (Unix LF):

check.cmd:
printf 'service: auth
version: 1.0
' | cmp -s - /home/user/cloud_migration/services/auth-service/config.yml && printf 'service: db
version: 1.0
' | cmp -s - /home/user/cloud_migration/services/db-service/config.yml && printf 'service: api
version: 1.0
' | cmp -s - /home/user/cloud_migration/services/api-service/config.yml

requirements.quote: Produce no extra files, directories or links beyond what is specified above.

check.cmd:
test "$(ls -A /home/user/current_services | sort | tr '
' ' ')" = 'all-services api.yaml auth.yaml db.yaml ' && test "$(ls -A /home/user/cloud_migration | sort | tr '
' ' ')" = 'migration_logs services ' && test "$(ls -A /home/user/cloud_migration/services | sort | tr '
' ' ')" = 'api-service auth-service db-service ' && test "$(ls -A /home/user/cloud_migration/migration_logs)" = symlink_audit.log
